items.title: Routing Screen Real Estate:  Your Agent Workspace Is the Next Routing Decision
items.summary: You Route Contacts with Precision. Why Not Screen Space? Before an agent ever sees their workspace, your routing engine evaluates multiple attributes to select an agent: skills, proficiency, queue priority, availability, routing profile, contact attributes, and business rules. It makes a calculated decision about who handles each interaction. The workspace itself? Typically, one size fits […]
